summary: The next deadline has one command for each manager. python3 -m src.live.session compiles xmi_t1 from news_packets, uses gwNN/betfair_t1 for match odds, anytime prices, and outright ranks, writes score_xp and forecast_xp, and chooses the squad on score_xp. --lock stores the decision, the untouched eleven, and the one-transfer eleven with both score_xp and ep_next. python3 -m src.str_agent.session fills the dossier, passes earlier notebook rows, and waits for --reply. From Gameweek 7 the string squad starts from the previous plan. --lock stores week 0. A late clock and a second row write no ledger bytes. Realised stays null. Gameweek 6 ledgers were not appended. The session was not run for Gameweek 7.
